ShipLog starts even when its data folder is mounted a little late, and the CA Auto Update warning shows only when it updates containers too.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **ShipLog starts even when its data folder is mounted a little late.** If the folder wasn't there yet when the array finished starting, ShipLog stayed stopped until the next array start. It now waits up to a minute for the folder. Thanks to @repires for the report and the fix ([#157](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/shiplog/issues/157)).
- **The CA Auto Update warning shows only when it updates containers too.** It appeared whenever CA Auto Update was installed, also when it only updated plugins. It now also says what to do, in all 26 languages. Thanks to @repires for pointing it out ([#152](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/shiplog/issues/152)).
